Bones of the Disir Queen®

How to Play

Step 1 — The Wager

The opponents greet one another and agree upon the trinkets to be wagered. Each player places their agreed wager into play before the contest begins.

Step 2 — Honor the Queen

Before play begins, the Queen must be acknowledged.

If a glass is present, a toast to the Queen is required.

If no drink is available, both players acknowledge the Queen and state together:

“For the Queen.”

Step 3 — The Queen’s Coin

Every Bones of the Disir Queen® game kit includes the Queen’s Coin.

One player produces the Queen’s Coin. The opponents choose heads or tails, and the coin is tossed. The winner chooses who will go first.

Going first establishes the order whenever player order matters, although most actions during the game occur at the same time.

Step 4 — Cast the Runes

Both players roll their seven Rune Stones and begin building the strongest scoring combinations possible.

If Loki’s Helm appears on one or more Runes, those Runes are dead for the round and cannot contribute toward a scoring combination.

Those Runes cannot be rerolled by either player, or by choosing an Ant to interfere with Fate, or by calling upon the Serpent Fate Bone.

Only by calling upon the Wolf Fate Bone can Loki’s Helm be challenged and those Runes rerolled.

Step 5 — The Queen’s Influence

After the initial cast, players may choose to call upon the Queen’s Influence, using her Ant armies to interfere with Fate.

One Ant allows a player to reroll one eligible non-Loki Rune.

Two Ants allow a player to reroll two eligible non-Loki Runes.

Once an Ant is used, it is gone for the remainder of the game.

The Ant armies cannot affect any Runes showing Loki’s Helm.

The Ant armies must be used before the Fate Bones are called upon.

Step 6 — Call Upon a Fate Bone

Players may call upon their Fate Bones to change the outcome of the round, and the game.

Wolf — Devour Fate: Choose to play the Wolf and: Reroll all seven Runes, including any Runes showing Loki’s Helm.

Raven — Steal Glory: Choose to play the Raven and: Subtract 5 points from the opponent’s score for the current round. The opponent’s round score cannot fall below zero.

Serpent — Twist Fate: Choose to play the Serpent and: Reroll exactly three eligible Runes. Runes showing Loki’s Helm cannot be rerolled.

Bear — Hold Fast: Choose to play the Bear and: Protect up to three active Runes. Protected Runes cannot be rerolled by Ants or Fate Bone effects.

Stag — Claim Honor: Choose to play the Stag and: Add 10 points to the player’s score for the current round.

The Round Is Set

Once all Runes have been played, the Fate Bone has been played, and any Ants chosen for that round have been spent, no further plays may be made.

Fate is set.

Step 7 — Score the Round

Determine each player’s final Rune combination and score the round. See the Scoring page. Apply any applicable Fate Bone scoring effects and record the final score for the round. Play continues until five rounds have been completed.

Step 8 — The Final Bone Judgment

At the conclusion of Round Five, the players face the Bone Judgment. Each player’s final Fate Bone faces the opponent’s final Fate Bone.

Wolf → Raven → Serpent → Bear → Stag

The higher-ranked Fate Bone wins. Wolf defeats Raven, Serpent, Bear and Stag. Raven defeats Serpent, Bear and Stag. Serpent defeats Bear and Stag. Bear defeats Stag.

The winner takes their Round 1 score, doubles it, and adds that doubled amount to their accumulated score.

If the Bone Judgment Is Tied

If both players reveal the same Fate Bone, the Bone Judgment ends in a tie. Neither player receives the Bone Judgment bonus. No additional Fate Bones are played and no tie-breaker is performed. The players’ existing scores are totaled as they stand.

A player may use the Judgment strategically to prevent an opponent from receiving the bonus, even when doing so means receiving no bonus themselves.

Step 9 — Claim the Wager

The victor claims the wagered trinket and earns the honor of recording the victory on the Scroll of Contrition as VICTORIOUS. The defeated player is recorded as FAILED.

NO CHAMPION HOLDS FORTUNE FOREVER.
